title: Moore: Benowitz operation as a 24-hour stage play
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: imagine the Benowitz operation as a 24-hour long stage play.

plain: A man named Bill Moore is said to have described the operation around a man named Benowitz, based near Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico between about 1970 and 1983, as something like a stage play running 24 hours a day. A guest named Greg Bishop passes this on from Moore, telling Michels to "imagine the Benowitz operation as a 24-hour long stage play." The point is that what Benowitz saw and heard may have been staged for him on purpose.
